August has arrived, and the AirPods Pro 3 $50 discount, AirPods Max 2 $100 discount, and the all-time low price deal on AirTag 2 are still going strong. However, today's midday deals spotlight from 9to5Toys falls on the M5 MacBook Air — we've spotted a rare $200 discount on the 24GB/512GB model, and we're also tracking up to $300 off on various configurations at the official Apple Certified Refurbished store, including this 24GB 15-inch model (more details here). These deals also include nearly $100 off on multiple Apple Watch Ultra 3 configurations, the latest Beats 240W Braided USB-C Cable (Black) for just $18, and a chance to grab the transparent red Beats Solo Buds for $40. See below for details.

Official Apple Refurbished Store now selling M5 MacBook Air at lowest prices, up to $300 off

With retail price increases for the latest MacBook lineup now a done deal, although we've uncovered notable discounts of up to $500, the official Apple Certified Refurbished Store is offering some of the best deals on select M5 MacBook Air configurations. We've previously highlighted the lowest-priced base model from a reliable source, but you can also pick up the 24GB 15-inch model there for $300 below the new retail price, available in Midnight, Silver, Starlight, and Sky Blue.

Official Apple Refurbished Store is now selling the 15-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 24GB RAM and 1TB storage for $1,699 with free shipping. As mentioned above, this deal applies to all four colors: Midnight, Silver, Starlight, and Sky Blue.

This was originally a $1,900 MacBook Air, currently going for over $1,999 across all configurations on Amazon.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (originally $1,299 new) — $200 off
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,359 (originally $1,599 new) — $240 off
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,699 (originally $1,999 new) — $300 off

Today's Apple refurb deals bring this machine's price back to its former pricing level, offering the best discount we've tracked since the price increase took effect. It appears these new official MSRPs will remain steady through year-end, or even longer. So while this isn't the all-time low price we've tracked, for anyone looking to pick up an M5 MacBook Air this year, this is definitely a worthwhile money-saving opportunity — similar deals on the next-generation MacBook Air lineup likely won't appear until later in 2027.

Browse all MacBook deals at the Apple Refurbished Store here — use the filters on the left side of the page to select your desired model.

Most affordable 15-inch 24GB M5 MacBook Air drops $200 today

Ongoing: Amazon's today-only deal takes $500 off the 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro

Although MacBook prices have just gone up, Amazon is still offering a substantial discount of up to $500 on the M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB/2TB this morning. This comes very close to the best price we tracked before the price increase took effect. See below for details.

Amazon is now selling the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB RAM and 2TB storage for $2,499 with free shipping.

Given that this machine currently retails for $2,999 at Apple and other channels, this effectively amounts to a $500 discount. The deal applies to Space Black and Silver models.

This is the best deal we've tracked on the M5 Pro model since the major retailer price increases took effect.

Prior to this, Amazon's deepest discount on this machine was $300, but they've just slashed an additional $200.

This still doesn't quite match the price levels we tracked for this configuration before the official price increase, but there's nothing we can do about it — it's a done deal. Taking everything into account, and considering that this machine's price increase happened roughly a month ago, this deal is only $100 off from the all-time low price we've seen for the M5 Pro.

Black and Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 models now available on Amazon with nearly $100 discount

Update: As we expected, Amazon has also lowered prices on several other Ultra 3 configurations, including the Natural titanium case model with the Anchor Blue Ocean band, with discounts approaching $100. See below for details.

While Series 11 models have consistently seen steady discounts, just as we saw at the start of August, deals on the Apple Watch Ultra 3 have remained relatively rare. However, this morning we spotted Amazon offering a nearly $100 discount on the Black Ultra 3 with a black "one size fits just about everyone" Ocean band.

Amazon is now selling the black titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with a matching black Ocean band for $699.99 with free shipping.

Originally priced at $799, this nearly $100 discount is the best deal we can find on a new unit from a reputable retailer.

Aside from a brief $150 discount during Amazon Prime Day, this deal rivals one of the best deals of the year, and is one of the few notable discounts worth watching on Amazon.

As of writing, the Black model with Ocean band is the only configuration enjoying a substantial discount. But if this deal follows the same pattern as last time, we're likely to see more color configurations discounted today and throughout the week.

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Black Ocean Band $700 (originally $799)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Anchor Blue Ocean Band $700 (originally $799)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Blue Trail Loop $700 (originally $799)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop $800 (originally $899)

If it's the Series 11 you're after, you can currently snag one well below the prices above:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (originally $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (originally $429)

Latest black Beats 240W Braided USB-C Cable drops to $18 with Prime shipping for members, an all-time low (40% off)

Today, grab the transparent red Beats Solo Buds for as low as $41

We were impressed by the Solo Buds' built-in battery life — this is currently the most affordable current-generation Beats wireless earbuds on the market. But at an MSRP of $80, typically selling for $70 on Amazon, grabbing them from Best Buy with shipping for $41 is an even better deal. Browse all Best Buy Beats deals here, and continue reading for Solo Buds deal details below.

Best Buy is now selling open-box transparent red Beats Solo Buds in "Excellent" condition for $40.99 with free shipping. That's nearly 50% below the official MSRP, and well below Amazon's $70 price for new units.

  • Functionality and appearance like new.
  • Includes all accessories and parts. Packaging may differ or be missing.

This is undoubtedly a more entry-level pair of earbuds, but it's also a current-generation Apple product going for just $41.

As mentioned above, the earbuds we've tested in person do deliver up to 18 hours of listening time on a single charge from the built-in battery. Although it doesn't come with a battery-equipped wireless charging case, it's more than sufficient for most users, especially at just $41. Other features include "one-tap seamless pairing," custom microphones utilizing "advanced noise-learning algorithms" for superior call quality, and industry-leading Class 1 Bluetooth.
